content.comment_body: I am using [product_name] [version_no] to control the pump operation and use [product_name] [version_no] to display the operation status. I use the VM to adjust the pump operation duration in [product_name]. Is it possible to show the last three pump operation dates and times in [product_name]?
You will need to implement your own solution. There is no direct way to access the date or time within the [product_name] program.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to display the last three pump operation date and time records using [product_name], but realizes that there is currently no direct way to access this temporal information in the [product_name] program, highlighting notable limitations for logging and event history functionality in the existing tools.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to offer a built-in or simple approach to record and display the date and time of the last three pump operations.
pain_keywords: no direct access to time data
